lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] Epsilon Cygni, thirty eighty-nine AD. All life on the exoplanet Lyra has been obliterated...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] ...apart from the holosonic vessel, Quantum Control. It escapes the poisonous atmosphere, the legacy of an entire civilisation stowed on board...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] ...a DNA-encrypted lifeform. The final gift from the dying elders: fifteen million zettabytes of Lyra's sacred ethnology, imprinted into its cells. The sacred encryption known as the Oblivious Transfer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] Four-dimensional manifold enabled, Quantum Control traverses the expanse of Cygnus A, into a slingshot that propels it into the orbit of an unknown planet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] Our fallen ship is intercepted by a scout patrol from an ancient tribe.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] Their plunder of Quantum Control's hold retrieves uranium, and the invaluable cryptid, still deep in hypersleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] In metabolic stasis, the psychedelic vibrations of their bonfire ritual...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [measured, calm] ...would soon trigger Ob-tran to begin its decode protocol.
